customer_question: This is the THIRD time I'm writing about the same thing. All our workflows are paused and order processing is down. We paid the invoice yesterday. I was promised a call back and got nothing, and every reply just says wait. Get me a manager NOW.
resolution: Escalated to billing at high priority: repeated contact, explicit request for a manager and a very angry customer on the Business plan (4-hour response time). The account had been suspended because an invoice stayed unpaid for 14 days after the payment failed; suspension pauses workflows but keeps data for 30 days. A billing manager confirmed the payment had arrived, reactivated the account and called the customer. Workflows resumed and no data was lost.
